 RESCENE Minami — Shines on MAMA Red Carpet in Hometown Japan
 Nov 20, 2026 3:13 AM PST 
 [Photo] OSEN DB. 
 The red carpet event for the 2026 MAMA Awards took place on November 20 near Kyocera Dome Osaka in Japan.
 Held over two days on November 20 and 21 at Kyocera Dome Osaka, the 2026 MAMA Awards operates under the concept “A MUSIC INTERSTELLAR,” aiming to present a new world connected through music.
 RESCENE Minami is seen walking the red carpet during the glamorous event.
